newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN ONE-DAY SERIES AFTER WASHOUT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN ONE-DAY SERIES AFTER WASHOUT.

text.p: Monday's second one-day international between India and Zimbabwe was called off on Sunday because of a waterlogged pitch at Harare Sports Club.
The washout gave Zimbabwe their second successive home victory in a one-day series after their 3-0 drubbing of England last month.
Zimbabwe won Saturday's opening limited overs match by eight wickets after rain reduced the home side's target to 136 in 38 overs.
It was only their second one-day win over India in 15 attempts.
